name: Darkness Revenge
source:
Jill and Nathan are two special agents. The two agents, are on the verge of framing notorious billionaire Donald Patterson. Things go awry, however, and the two are killed.

When it all seems to be over, the vampire Laura decides to save one of the two agents. Thus begins the revenge.

Darkness revenge is an adult visual novel where you can play as Jill or Nathan. After the introduction you will then have to choose whether to play with a female or male role.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2112680/Darkness_Revenge/]Steam[/url]]
